scheme_name: Tuition Fees And Examination Fees To Vjnt/sbc Students Studying In High Schools
other_conditions: Student must be enrolled in a recognized high school
Student must belong to VJNT or SBC category
Students who have failed once are eligible
Students who have failed twice are not eligible
benefits_summary: Tuition, examination, library, laboratory and playground fees are paid for eligible VJNT/SBC high‑school students, with an education fee of Rs 100–200 per student.
